newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo tea prices rise across the board.
newsitem.headline: Colombo tea prices rise across the board.

text.p: Sri Lankan tea prices rose across the board at the Colombo auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Better Western BOPs rose two-four rupees and more for the best on offer, they said.
BOPFs gained five-eight rupees and more following special inquiry, they said.
Demand for low growns, the mainstay of the market in recent months, came from the Commonwealth of Independent States, the Middle East and Germany, they said.
The anticipated auction average price for the 4.3 million kg on offer was 114 rupees per kg compared to 110.16 rupees last week, brokers Forbes and Walker said.
The next auction is on September 3-4 when 4.5 million kg will be on offer.
